title: The Daily Compass｜每日罗盘
subtitle: A bilingual daily briefing for navigating global news, culture, AI, and social change.
theme: 被困、被看见与重新启动：空气污染、无指控拘留、照护者债务、首尔Pride、酷儿喜剧与航天安全
introChinese: 今天的小报关键词是：visibility, vulnerability, and recovery（可见性、脆弱性与恢复）。火灾让城市空气成为公共风险，无薪照护者被福利系统困在债务中，Pride让身份进入街道，而科技与文化机构则必须回答：一次失败或长期忽视之后，如何真正重新开始。

items.title: 加州大型仓库火灾持续三天，空气质量受到影响
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，加州 Tracy 一座约100万平方英尺的医疗用品仓库大火进入第三天，消防人员仍难以控制，超过10万居民城市的空气质量受到影响。工业火灾不是孤立的建筑事故，它会通过烟雾、物流中断和公共卫生风险扩散到整个社区。
items.correspondingEnglish: A fire at a one-million-square-foot medical-supply warehouse in Tracy, California, continued into a third day. Firefighters said they were struggling to contain it, and air quality was affected across a city of more than 100,000 residents. Industrial fires can spread risk through smoke, disrupted logistics and public-health pressure.

englishExpressions.example: Firefighters struggled to contain the fire.
Officials issued an air-quality warning.
An industrial accident can affect an entire community.

items.title: 巴勒斯坦裔美国女大学生被以色列军方无指控拘留
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，20岁的大学生 Sama Safi 与巴勒斯坦女子国家足球队成员一同被以色列士兵拘捕，目前未受到正式指控。无指控拘留使个人难以了解证据、准备辩护或判断何时获释，也让法律程序本身成为人权问题。
items.correspondingEnglish: Palestinian American university student Sama Safi, 20, was arrested by Israeli soldiers along with members of the Palestinian women’s national soccer team and held without charge. Detention without charge limits a person’s ability to examine evidence, prepare a defense or know when release may come.

englishExpressions.example: The student was held without charge.
Human-rights groups called for due process.
A detainee needs access to evidence to prepare a defense.

items.title: 英国福利系统仍让无薪照护者累积债务
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，英国就业与养老金部在已收到停止付款请求后，仍继续向部分无薪照护者发放补助，随后又追讨所谓多付款项。照护者本已承担大量无报酬劳动，行政失误却把责任与债务转嫁给他们，显示系统复杂性本身也会制造伤害。
items.correspondingEnglish: The UK Department for Work and Pensions continued allowing unpaid carers to accumulate debts even after being told about overpayments. One carer repeatedly asked for payments to stop but received the benefit for another six months. Administrative complexity can transfer institutional mistakes onto people already performing large amounts of unpaid labor.

englishExpressions.example: Unpaid carers provide essential daily support.
The department later demanded repayment of the benefit overpayment.
Complex rules create an administrative burden for families.

items.title: 首尔街头被Pride色彩填满：不要假装我们不存在
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，首尔Pride活动让参与者能够公开表达身份。一名参与者表示，这是许多人一年中唯一感到可以真正做自己的时刻。在法律保护仍不充分的环境中，庆典不仅是欢乐，也是一种要求被看见、被承认的政治行动。
items.correspondingEnglish: Seoul filled its streets with Pride color as LGBTQ+ people gathered for a rare moment of open self-expression. One attendee said it was the one time of year when people felt they could truly show who they were. Where legal protections remain limited, celebration also becomes a demand for recognition.

englishExpressions.example: Pride creates space for open self-expression.
Many communities still lack adequate legal protection.
Public visibility can become a demand for recognition.

sections.heading: 艺术、时尚与媒体 / Art, Fashion & Media

items.title: David Hockney改变艺术的十种方式
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 回顾 David Hockney 如何推动风景画、打破单点透视、塑造洛杉矶视觉风格，并拥抱iPad创作与舞台设计。他的影响力来自不断更换媒介，而不是固守一种标志风格。技术在这里不是艺术的替代者，而是重新组织观看的方法。
items.correspondingEnglish: The Guardian identified 10 ways David Hockney changed art: transforming landscape painting, challenging one-point perspective, creating the Los Angeles look, embracing iPads and designing stage sets. His influence came from moving across media rather than protecting a single signature style.

englishExpressions.example: Hockney challenged traditional one-point perspective.
The artist continued to move across media.
His work created a recognizable visual language.

items.title: Drag喜剧《Stop! That! Train!》想成为所有人的电影
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 采访Drag喜剧《Stop! That! Train!》的导演与演员。创作者强调这不是只为《RuPaul’s Drag Race》粉丝制作的作品，而是借鉴《Airplane!》式荒诞喜剧面向更广泛观众。酷儿文化不必总被放在解释身份的位置，也可以单纯制造笑声与流行娱乐。
items.correspondingEnglish: The director and drag-queen actors behind Stop! That! Train! described it as a comedy for everyone, not only Drag Race fans. The film gives an Airplane!-style parody a deliberately queer and chaotic twist. Queer culture does not always have to explain identity; it can also create mainstream laughter and entertainment.

englishExpressions.example: The film is designed as a madcap parody.
The creators hope to reach a broader audience.
Queer comedy can thrive without explaining itself.

sections.heading: 人工智能与科技 / AI & Tech

items.title: Blue Origin称爆炸后年内将恢复飞行，NASA任务等待验证
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，Blue Origin 表示在发射台爆炸后计划于年内恢复飞行。NASA的Artemis III任务需要该公司相关能力，因此复飞不只是商业公司自身进度，也关系到公共太空计划。恢复运行需要公开事故原因、修正措施和可验证的安全测试。
items.correspondingEnglish: Blue Origin said it expected to fly again this year after an explosion on the launchpad. NASA needs the company’s technology for Artemis III, making the recovery important to a public space program as well as a private company. A credible return requires an explanation of the failure, corrective action and verifiable safety testing.

englishExpressions.example: The company plans to return to flight this year.
Engineers must document the corrective action.
The next launch will be a major safety validation.

items.title: 儿童网络安全倡导者：大型科技需要自己的“烟草时刻”
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 采访导演、上议院议员和网络安全倡导者 Beeban Kidron。她认为大型科技公司向儿童提供有害产品却长期逃避责任，需要像烟草行业一样面对明确的健康证据与监管转折。儿童安全不能只依赖家长设置，也必须进入产品设计与法律责任。
items.correspondingEnglish: Film director, peer and online-safety campaigner Beeban Kidron argued that big technology needs its own “tobacco moment”. She said companies had placed harmful products in children’s hands while failing to prevent abuse. Child safety cannot depend only on parental controls; it must be built into product design and legal responsibility.

englishExpressions.example: Kidron has campaigned for stronger online safety.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 设计即安全；在产品设计阶段纳入安全
englishExpressions.example: Children’s platforms should adopt safety by design.
Public evidence can create a regulatory turning point.

englishParagraph.english: Today’s stories focus on what happens when people or institutions become trapped. Smoke traps a city inside an industrial emergency. Detention without charge traps a person outside ordinary legal protection. Administrative mistakes trap carers in debt. Pride creates visibility against social erasure, while comedy and visual art open new routes into public culture. In technology, recovery requires more than restarting a rocket or changing a parental setting; it requires evidence, safer design and institutions willing to accept responsibility.
englishParagraph.chinese: 今天的新闻关注人或机构被困住时会发生什么。烟雾让一座城市陷入工业紧急状态，无指控拘留让个人被排除在普通法律保护之外，行政错误让照护者陷入债务。Pride以可见性对抗社会抹除，喜剧与视觉艺术则打开进入公共文化的新路径。在科技领域，恢复不能只是重新发射火箭或调整家长设置，它还需要证据、更安全的设计，以及愿意承担责任的机构。

keywords.meaning: 可见性；被社会看见与承认
keywords.example: Pride increases public visibility for LGBTQ+ communities.
Detention without charge raises due-process concerns.
Complex benefit rules create an administrative burden.
Artists build a visual language across different media.
A return to flight requires safety validation.

keywords.meaning: 设计即安全；在设计阶段纳入保护机制
keywords.example: Children’s apps should follow safety-by-design principles.

sentenceLab.sentence: Recovery requires more than restarting a rocket or changing a parental setting.
sentenceLab.analysisChinese: requires more than 表示“需要的不只是……”。两个动名词短语 restarting a rocket 和 changing a parental setting 并列，指出表面修复与结构性恢复之间的差别。

reflection.english: Recovery begins when visibility leads to evidence, protection and responsibility.
reflection.chinese: 今天最想留下的一句话是：当可见性能够进一步带来证据、保护与责任，恢复才真正开始。
